title: Jesus... I Called Her Gift My Favourite
topic: she told her athai her Diwali gift is her favourite when it is not, and the small lie is eating at her

bible.text: Therefore each of you must put off falsehood and speak truthfully to his neighbor, for we are all members of one another.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... Athai's Diwali gift. Why did I call it my favourite? 🎁

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: She spent her bonus on it. It sits in my cupboard and I feel sick.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: The lie was small. It costs you the truth with someone who loves you.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: If I tell her, she'll be hurt. Isn't hiding it kinder?

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Kindness that needs a lie isn't kindness. It's a debt you keep paying.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Honour a gift without pretending. Wear it only when you mean the smile.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: What's the last kind lie you told? 👇
